name: codex-chromapaw
description: Build one-image Codex skin or pet packages with explicit dependency and activation gates.

interface.shortDescription: Build reviewed Codex skin or pet packages from one image.
interface.longDescription: ChromaPaw builds an image-specific Skin Studio v2 package with contrast-safe IDE colors, or a validated animated pet when a compatible hatch-pet workflow is installed. Some skin inputs require the host's image-generation capability. Live skin activation is experimental and limited to enabled exact-version Windows adapters; macOS support is currently a read-only compatibility probe.
defaultPrompt: Turn this image into an animated Codex pet.
Turn this image into a layered Codex skin.
Inspect or restore my ChromaPaw customization.
